fusions.name: Strand Snare
fusions.desc: Sends a fine strand into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spun Razors
fusions.desc: Lashes every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 slashing damage and leaving each [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Mantle
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangled Count
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
